summary: Eldorado Gold Corporation filed a Form 6-K with a news release providing details for its Q2 2026 earnings conference call scheduled for July 31, 2026. The filing consists solely of logistical information for the call, including date, time, dial-in numbers, and webcast link. There are no mentions of any special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. This is a routine quarterly reporting item with no transactional or structural corporate event.
